text:
```yaml
name: Validate OpenAPI Specs

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'openapi*.yml'
      - 'envd.yaml'

jobs:
  validate-openapi:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        spec:
          - openapi.yml
          - openapi-edge.yml
          - openapi-hyperloop.yml
          - envd.yaml

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install -g @redocly/cli

    - name: Validate OpenAPI spec
      run: redocly lint ${{ matrix.spec }} --config .redocly.yaml
      continue-on-error: false
```
